statement: Agent CLI overhead dominates token use: in a live small code change, Orchestrator prompts were ~939 tokens (estimated) while providers reported 162,540 exact input tokens (Codex implementer 77,976 + Claude reviewer 84,564), 99.4% of it CLI system prompt, tools and exploration.
